entities.summary: Luiz Felipe Marques Fonteles is a Brazilian volleyball player, member of the Brazil men's national volleyball team in 2005–2016 and previously played for Japanese team, JTEKT Stings, on club level. He is the 2016 Olympic Champion, silver medallist of the 2014 World Championship, two–time South American Champion and gold medallist of the 2011 Pan American Games.
